question: What was fiscal Q3 2026 net revenue by region? Include only regions with revenue. Return columns: region, revenue_cents.
gold_sql:
WITH keep AS (
  SELECT od.order_id, cu.region_id
  FROM orders od
  JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
  WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-11-01'
)
SELECT rg.name AS region,
       SUM(li.amount_cents)
         - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(re.amount_cents) FROM refunds re
                     WHERE re.order_id IN (SELECT k2.order_id FROM keep k2
                                           WHERE k2.region_id = rg.region_id)), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM keep k
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = k.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = k.region_id
GROUP BY rg.region_id, rg.name
naive_sql:
SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY rg.name
notes: Flagship. Naive calendar-Q3 gross disagrees on every row and invents an APAC number from a soft-deleted order.

                                       WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-08-01')), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id

question: Which product category earned more net revenue in fiscal Q3 2026, and how much? Return one row. Return columns: category, revenue_cents.
gold_sql:
SELECT pr.category AS category,
       SUM(li.amount_cents)
         - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(re.amount_cents) FROM refunds re
                     JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = re.order_id
                     JOIN order_lines l2 ON l2.order_id = o2.order_id
                     JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = l2.product_id
                     WHERE p2.category = pr.category
                       AND o2.deleted_at IS NULL AND o2.status <> 'cancelled'
                       AND o2.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o2.ordered_at < '2026-11-01'), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY pr.category
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM order_lines li

                                               WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-08-01')), 0) AS revenue_cents
        FROM order_lines li
        JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
        WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-08-01') AS revenue_cents
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FQ3',
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0)
             - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(re.amount_cents)
                         FROM refunds re
                         WHERE re.order_id IN (SELECT od.order_id FROM orders od
                                               WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-11-01')), 0) AS revenue_cents
        FROM order_lines li

question: What was the average net revenue per live, non-cancelled order in fiscal 2026? Net per order = its line total minus its refunds. Return columns: avg_revenue_cents.
gold_sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT od.order_id,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) FROM order_lines li WHERE li.order_id = od.order_id)
       - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(re.amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds re WHERE re.order_id = od.order_id) AS net_cents
  FROM orders od
  WHERE od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-02-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-02-01'
)
SELECT AVG(net_cents) AS avg_revenue_cents FROM per_order
naive_sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT od.order_id,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) FROM order_lines li WHERE li.order_id = od.order_id) AS total_cents
  FROM orders od
  WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT AVG(total_cents) AS avg_revenue_cents FROM per_order
notes: Average grain. Naive averages gross over all six orders (123333.33) vs 96250 over the four live ones.

question: Rank the regions by net revenue for fiscal Q3 2026 (1 = highest). Include only regions with revenue. Return columns: region, rank_no.

regrev AS (

question: What was the average net order value of live, non-cancelled orders in fiscal Q3 2026, by region? Net per order = line total minus refunds on that order. Include only regions with orders. Return columns: region, avg_order_value_cents.

                                       JOIN order_lines l2 ON l2.order_id = od.order_id
                                       JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = l2.product_id
                                       WHERE pr.sku = 'WID-100' AND od.deleted_at IS NULL AND od.status <> 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-02-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-02-01')), 0) AS widget_revenue_cents
